description: This file defines an interface named UploadedFileFactoryInterface in the Psr\Http\Message namespace. It specifies a method for creating uploaded file objects, including detailed parameters for stream, size, error code, client filename, and media type.

classes.name: UploadedFileFactoryInterface
classes.description: An interface for creating uploaded file instances, specifying the createUploadedFile method.
